mentions.name: Generic tree-processing library
mentions.description: A generic tree-processing library that makes operations on directory trees much nicer than Python's standard library walk functions; it is a dependency of PAPER and is being documented and prepared for a proper release.
mentions.problem: Operations on directory trees are cumbersome with the standard library "walk"s.
mentions.source_excerpt: I need to document and properly release one of the pieces that PAPER is relying on (some generic tree-processing code that makes operations on directory trees a lot nicer than with the standard library "walk"s)
